newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's foreign reserves jump to $18.449 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's foreign reserves jump to $18.449 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's foreign reserves rose $2.074 billion, or 12.7 percent, to $18.449 billion in the week to Aug 11, according to figures released by the Central Bank Friday.
Reserves were up from $16.375 bln on Aug 4, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
The Bank gave no explanation for the sharp rise in reserves, which have hovered around $16 billion for most of the year.
However, market analysts said the increase was most likely due to proceeds from the auction of 17 oil contracts in June, payments for which had to be made in the first week of August.
Since the start of the year, reserve levels have risen $3.270 billion, or 21.5 percent. Reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, last year to $15.179 billion.
